accent.purpose: The single accent. Marks what is live and what is current: link underlines, the article drop cap, active filter chips, status dots, focus rings.

accent-secondary.purpose: The far stop of the section micro-label gradient, and nowhere else. A gradient terminator, not a second accent.

accent-light.purpose: Tint behind blockquotes and soft-selected pipeline nodes.

bg.purpose: The page ground. Carries the fractal-noise grain overlay at 2.8% multiply.

surface.purpose: Card and panel ground, one step off the page.

fg.purpose: Full-strength text, primary button ground, and the hover border on nothing else.

fg-muted.purpose: Body and prose copy. Body text never runs at full Ink.

fg-faint.purpose: Timestamps, list markers, captions, placeholder text.

border.purpose: Default card and panel stroke; the mid stop of every chapter rule.

border-strong.purpose: Card hover border and the heavy end of a chapter rule.

dark-bg.purpose: True black dark ground, OLED-ready. Grain flips to 1.8% screen.

dark-accent.purpose: Signal Indigo lightened to survive a true-black ground.

dark-fg.purpose: Dark-mode text. Deliberately not pure white.

display.purpose: Hero headlines and chapter labels. EB Garamond promoted to headline duty via .display-serif, never by overriding --font-display.

headline.purpose: Page h1. Roboto under the default midnight theme; Inter otherwise.

prose.purpose: Long-form article and lab body in Source Serif 4 at a 68ch measure. Never overridden by a theme.

label.purpose: Chips, eyebrows, and section micro-labels at 0.625rem.

signature.purpose: The Cormorant Garamond italic sign-off mark. One consumer only.

mono.purpose: Code, metrics, keycaps, and trace output in Geist Mono.

shadows.name: card-rest-light
shadows.purpose: Light-mode cards are flat at rest. Depth in light mode is motion, not shadow.

shadows.name: card-rest-dark
shadows.purpose: Dark-mode resting card depth, tuned blue-black rather than neutral.

shadows.name: card-hover-light
shadows.purpose: Applied by .card-lift on hover, arriving with the 3px raise.

shadows.name: stack-light
shadows.purpose: Upward-cast shadow so a stacking section reads as sliding over the previous one.

shadows.name: stack-dark
shadows.purpose: Dark variant of the section stacking shadow.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Global :focus-visible treatment. Fields suppress it and shift their border to accent instead.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: State response: scroll reveals (0.55s), card lift (0.3s), drawers.

motion.name: ease-entrance
motion.purpose: Entrances: page transition (0.4s), the ink rule (900ms).

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Global active state on every non-disabled button and a[role=button].

motion.name: theme-crossfade
motion.value: background-color 0.25s ease, color 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Reveals resolve to visible with no transition; ambient loops disabled. Required on all new motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one call to action: ink on paper, pill geometry. Never the accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--fg); color: var(--bg); border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.375rem 1.25rem; font-family: var(--font-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.75; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); transition-duration: 75ms; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: In-context action inside a tool surface. Chip radius, never the page's main CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-fg); border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.875rem; font-family: var(--font-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-accent:active { transform: scale(0.97); transition-duration: 75ms; }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: Flat at rest in light, lifting 3px on hover with the border shifting to the spine rule.
components.html:
RAG retrieval pipeline

Hybrid BM25 + dense retrieval with RRF merge, cutting P99 by 78%.
components.css: .ds-card { display: block; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 1rem; padding: 1.25rem; box-shadow: var(--shadow-card); transition: box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 0.3s ease; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-hover); border-color: var(--border-strong); } .ds-card:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.99); transition-duration: 75ms; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.015em; color: var(--fg); } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.8; color: var(--fg-muted); }

components.name: Filter Chip (Selected)
components.description: Active filter state. One of the few places Signal Indigo becomes a background.
components.css: .ds-chip-active { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-fg); border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.125rem 0.625rem; font-family: var(--font-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-chip-active:active { transform: scale(0.97); transition-duration: 75ms; }

components.name: Filter Chip (Unselected)
components.description: Resting filter state. Hover warms the label to full ink and hints the accent on the border.
components.css: .ds-chip { background: var(--surface); color: var(--fg-faint); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.125rem 0.625rem; font-family: var(--font-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { color: var(--fg); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 50%, transparent); } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.97); transition-duration: 75ms; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: The border is the focus indicator; the global ring is suppressed on fields.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: var(--bg); color: var(--fg); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font-family: var(--font-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--fg-faint); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; }

components.name: Search Trigger
components.description: Nav search affordance with a platform-detected keycap. Pill on the raised surface.
components.css: .ds-search { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; width: 14rem; background: var(--surface-raised); color: var(--fg-faint); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.375rem 0.375rem 0.375rem 0.875rem; font-family: var(--font-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-search:hover { color: var(--fg); border-color: var(--fg-muted); } .ds-search span { flex: 1; text-align: left; } .ds-kbd { margin-left: auto; background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0.375rem; padding: 0.125rem 0.375rem; font-family: var(--font-mono), ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1; color: var(--fg-faint); }

components.name: Live Status Dot
components.description: Signature liveness marker on shipped products — a pinging halo behind a solid accent dot. The canonical 'this is still running' signal.
components.html: Live since Aug 2020
components.css: .ds-live { position: relative; display: inline-flex; height: 0.375rem; width: 0.375rem; margin-right: 0.5rem; } .ds-live-ping { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--accent); opacity: 0.6; animation: ds-ping 1.6s cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1) infinite; } .ds-live-dot { position: relative; height: 0.375rem; width: 0.375rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--accent); } .ds-live-label { font-family: var(--font-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; color: var(--fg-faint); } @keyframes ds-ping { 75%, 100% { transform: scale(2.2); opacity: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-live-ping { animation: none; } }

components.name: Drop Cap Paragraph
components.description: The long-form 'settle in' signal: a Garamond initial in Signal Indigo over a slightly enlarged opening paragraph.
components.html: Retrieval is the part everyone skips. The model is downstream of whatever you hand it, so the interesting work happens before a single token is generated.
components.css: .ds-dropcap { max-width: 68ch; margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-blog), Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.09rem; line-height: 1.72; color: var(--fg-subtle); hanging-punctuation: first allow-end last; } .ds-dropcap::first-letter { float: left; font-family: var(--font-garamond), Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 3.1em; line-height: 0.78; margin: 0.02em 0.12em 0 0; color: var(--accent); }

narrative.overview:
This system is built on a casting decision, not a style. Every typeface on the site is an assigned speaker, and the assignment is the rule that makes nine loaded fonts read as discipline instead of indulgence. Roboto is the system talking — chrome, headings, UI, the default voice a visitor meets. Garamond is Jaya talking — the hero, the chapter labels, the prose headings, the signature. Geist Mono is the machine reporting — code, metrics, keyboard hints, trace output. A visitor never has to be told which is which; they can hear it.

The material underneath is newsprint. A fractal-noise grain sits over every page at 2.8% opacity in multiply, dropping to 1.8% in screen on dark. Column rules are heavy at the spine and fade to nothing before the margin, the way a printed rule does. Long-form text carries hanging punctuation, a Garamond drop cap in the accent, balanced heading wraps, and a 68ch measure. The homepage is a single continuous column of numbered chapters at every viewport width — one DOM tree, no layout branch, the rail going sticky only at lg.

Restraint is the default state and response is earned by contact. Cards carry no shadow at all in light mode; depth arrives only on hover, as a 3px lift. Every button drops to scale(0.97) in 75ms when pressed. The palette is almost entirely ink and paper, with one indigo held back for the few things that are genuinely live.
keyCharacteristics: Nine typefaces, each with exactly one assigned speaker
Newsprint grain over every surface; column rules that fade to the margin
Ink-on-paper primary actions — the accent is never the main button
Flat in light, materially deep in dark; two different papers, not one tinted
Motion is a single easing curve (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) plus a 75ms press
A serif that survives every theme, because the author's voice is not themeable

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: The primary action is ink on paper — fg background, bg text, pill geometry. Signal Indigo is never the primary button. It marks state and liveness; the moment it becomes a call to action it stops meaning anything.

rules.name: The Two Papers Rule
rules.body: Light and dark are not one palette in two tints. Light is paper: flat, no card shadow, grain in multiply. Dark is pure black: real layered shadows, grain in screen. Never port a treatment across without re-deciding it.

rules.name: The Cool Newsprint Rule
rules.body: The intended neutral character is a cool blue-slate off-white with deep blue-black ink, as the token comments state. The shipped hexes have drifted warm — #fefefb is bone, #181410 is a brown-black, #c6c2bb is a warm gray. The cool intent is normative; the current values are the incumbent implementation pending correction. Do not add new neutrals matching the warm drift.

rules.name: The Assigned Speaker Rule
rules.body: Before adding a typeface, name its speaker. If the job belongs to a voice already cast — system, author, machine, reader — use that face. A tenth font with no speaker is a bug.

rules.name: The Unthemeable Voice Rule
rules.body: --font-garamond, --font-cormorant, and --font-blog are never overridden by a theme. Themes may swap the system's voice; they may not swap the author's or the reader's.

rules.name: The Escape Hatch Rule
rules.body: Promote a serif to headline duty with the .display-serif class, never by overriding --font-display. That variable is how midnight swaps the whole site to Roboto, and both subdomains inherit it — overriding it breaks the default experience and two other products at once.

rules.name: The One Column Rule
rules.body: The page reads as one column at every width. Responsive work adjusts rhythm and stickiness, never the number of columns the eye has to track.

rules.name: The Earned Depth Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest in light mode. A shadow is a response to state — hover, stacking, focus — never decoration on an idle element.

rules.name: The Three Corners Rule
rules.body: Every radius comes from chip (0.5rem), panel (0.75rem), or card (1rem) — or it is a pill. An arbitrary rounded-[14px] is a bug.

rules.name: The Two Curves Rule
rules.body: New motion uses cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for state response or cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) for entrances. Bounce and elastic easing are not part of this system.

dos: Do make the primary action ink-on-paper (bg-fg text-bg, pill) and let Signal Indigo mark state instead.
Do assign a speaker before adding a typeface — system (Roboto), author (Garamond), machine (Geist Mono), or reader (Source Serif 4).
Do promote a serif to headline duty with .display-serif, never by overriding --font-display.
Do pick radii from chip (0.5rem), panel (0.75rem), or card (1rem), or use a pill.
Do use .card-lift for interactive cards so the 3px hover, the border shift, and the 75ms press all arrive together.
Do set reading measures in ch (68 for prose, 62 or 56 for narrow passages).
Do carry prefers-reduced-motion on every new animation — the homepage is motion-dense and the media query is already the house standard.
Do reference semantic tokens (bg-surface, text-fg-muted, border-border) rather than raw Tailwind palette classes.
donts: Don't build the generic developer-portfolio dark mode — neon-on-black, monospace-everything, glowing gradient orbs. Mono is a reporting voice here, not a theme.
Don't add a shadow to a light-mode element at rest. Depth in light is motion and border weight.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing; the system has exactly two curves.
Don't animate width, height, padding, or margin. Use transform and opacity.
Don't spread Signal Indigo into decoration — it means 'live' or 'current,' and dilution costs it that meaning.
Don't introduce new neutrals matching the current warm drift; the intended character is cool blue-slate.
Don't override --font-garamond, --font-cormorant, or --font-blog in a theme. The author's and reader's voices are not themeable.
Don't branch the homepage into a second layout tree for mobile — one column, one DOM, stickiness toggled at lg.
